fix_attempts.comment: Fourfold reduction of the ideal commanded inertial term versus 300 s; friction/latch peaks do not scale this way. Slower staged commissioning does not raise the deployed frequency.
Not adopted: a roughly hundredfold tube-stiffness increase breaks thin-panel stow and cascades geometry/mass. A guyed/trussed wing is a future detail-design task, not silently credited.
fix_attempts.option: Raise radiator f1 to 0.05 Hz by tube-metal stiffness alone

deployed_radiator.status: LOW FREQUENCY / OPEN for attitude-control interaction. Rigid latches are an upper-bound stiffness; no deployed frequency cap supplied.

global_structural.qualification: Screening only; do not put launcher/deployed frequency PASS or elastic solar-array qualification on poster.
global_structural.scope:
Rerun historical stack_modes with actual v3 spacecraft mass and revised packing.
Also an Euler-Bernoulli FE screen of one deployed 10-panel radiator column using
seven circular tubes and wet/inventory loading. Neither includes joint/launcher compliance.
Solar blanket EI was NEVER specified by the prior rigid Newton model: required EI is
reported rather than inventing an elastic laminate and claiming solar-array FEA closure.

stack.status: OPEN: Falcon 25/10-Hz proxy is not a Starship requirement; strength-sized rigid-base estimate only. Cannot certify frequencies or launcher loads from unsigned stack layout.

header.reason: Rigid 43.4/64.2-mm short-end wrap intersects neighboring headers at the required 10-mm fold. Explicit enlarged-stack packing fails 30. Retractable bumpers or staggered headers need new mechanisms/root routing and a new packing architecture (large cascading changes), not a clean header-only adoption. Thermal and launch-mass lower bounds alone are not closure.

results.mass_scope: Shield+small array growth only; no pipe mass credit and no rerouting mechanism allowance. Thus optimistic lower-bound mass, not a complete revised ledger.

cases.latch_damping_policy: 0.7 critical against min(outboard inertia, 64 times own hinge inertia); hardware qualification OPEN
cases.scope:
Rerun existing Newton Featherstone + Warp reference on final masses and spans.
Rigid panels, fixed bus; mirror-pair reactions cancel by ideal symmetry only. No Newton
contact claim: independent finite-box geometry checks are mandatory. Model setup fixes:
full sc mass, actual 4.1366-m bus-axis root, 140-panel loading, finite hinge/COM offsets, root-first motor sequence, 5-kNm/rad damped latches, motor disabled after lock, latch damping sized to bounded outboard inertia, graph batch 100.

operational.average_requirement_status: OPEN: public 175 kW average is not met by this175-kW sunlit pause/restart schedule; wording is nominal (sunlit) pending author decision.

boiling.qualification: 3 bar is the fluid-property evaluation pressure, NOT a specified accumulator setpoint. Pure-water surrogate is not a validated MPG40 saturation calculation; pressurization, transients and life remain OPEN.

hydraulic.qualification: Smooth circular straight-tube Darcy screen only; headers, root hoses, fittings, roughness and full circuit qualification OPEN. No pump/mass credit.

module_seam.scope:
One-dimensional exact SAT support bound for the recorded width-fold path.
Shrinking only finite opaque leaf bodies inside unchanged gross module/hinge envelopes.
Assembly masses, hinge pitch and conservative gross assembly inertia unchanged.

operational.optical_basis: BOL epsilon0.92/alpha0.20. Deterministic epsilon sensitivity uses the frozen surrogate/independent SciPy root delta anchored to native inlet. Not EOL coating qualification.

public_envelope.qualification: Public dimensions are approximate; axis interpretation is ours, not reverse-engineered flight geometry.

safe_mode_energy.qualification: OPEN: assumed safe-mode bus equals modeled sunlit auxiliary load; usable capacity, aging, temperature, reserve, heater/ADCS loads and cycle life not certified.

operational.scope: Supplementary no-credit screens. Engineering assumptions explicit; no geometry/mass/solar-size changes.

optical.mast_screen: Conservative opaque-area bound, not a validated prediction; a new conducting/radiating support model and altered packing would be required.
optical.scope: Native-model optical screens; no added thermal or mass credit adopted.

packing.caveat: Idealized component envelopes, inherited 50-mm adapters and 20-mm interlayer gap; connected harness/hinge interfaces, rails, CG and flight dispenser remain OPEN.
packing.scope: Independent exact AABB + payload-profile validation of constructive packing.

yoke.qualification: OPEN: fabricated wall tolerance, braze/re-age and fittings, local distortion, panel/hinge flexibility, complete load path. 4.1 kg is a historical root-model allowance within existing structure/deployment lines, not a new independent ledger credit.

reinforcement_trial.verdict: NOT ADOPTED: 120-mm mast contradicts 10-mm integrated fold; four new 1.2-m-high bundles and forty structural hinges, optical/thermal recoupling and packing redesign are large cascading changes. Frequencies alone do not close a deployable radiator.

yoke.scope:
Finite-element beam screen of repaired five-cell Al6061 root yoke.
Includes the full rigid solar-wing translation/rotation mass matrix; solar laminate
flexibility and latch compliance omitted, so frequencies are upper-bound screens.
The 4.1-kg historical root allocation is retained; no metal-mass credit is taken.

yoke_loads.qualification: Allocated damper/hinge masses, manufacturing tolerance, fittings/bearing, local launch support and flexible-wing coupling remain OPEN.
